visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white cat lies completely on its back, belly exposed, on a circular grey scratching pad with a textured surface. The cat's eyes are closed, and its front and back paws are curled lazily in the air, indicating a state of very deep and comfortable sleep. The scene is illuminated by bright, natural daylight coming from a nearby window, which shows a blurred urban background with hints of red and green. (2) The camera maintains a medium close-up on the cat, focusing on its face and front paws. The cat remains perfectly still, its breathing barely noticeable. A human hand briefly enters the top left of the frame, pointing a finger towards the cat's belly as if to highlight its funny sleeping position. The lighting remains consistent, creating a soft and peaceful atmosphere. (3) The framing shifts slightly down to capture the cat's fluffy white chest and orange belly patches. The cat continues to sleep undisturbed. The background remains the same indoor setting with the grey scratcher as the main stage. The overall visual tone is natural and bright, emphasizing the cat's soft fur texture and relaxed state. (4) A hand wearing a gold chain bracelet enters from the bottom right and gently pokes the cat's belly and soft paws. The cat stays asleep, showing no reaction to the initial touch. The camera captures the interaction in a close-up, highlighting the contrast between the human hand and the cat's immobile, fluffy form. (5) The hand begins to vigorously rub and scratch the cat's stomach. The cat wakes up slightly, stretching its front legs wide and then pulling them back in while staying on its back. Its head tilts back further, and its mouth opens slightly in a yawn or a silent sigh of contentment. The movement is fluid and slow, matching the relaxed vibe. (6) The petting moves up to the cat's neck and jaw area. The cat continues to stretch and wiggle its body on the scratcher, clearly enjoying the physical affection. The camera follows the movement closely. The video ends with the cat still lying on its back, fully pampered and looking extremely satisfied.
